derivation: SHA-256 keyed ordering (see ruthless_pipeline/certification/p1_pairing_schedule.py); no random module, no wall clock
matched_pair_rule: Each trial is one matched pair: one control capture and one candidate capture of the same grid cell, same session, same variant/size; the pair differs ONLY in the printed artwork. Control-undetected trials are invalid measurement conditions, never candidate successes (STOPPING_RULE.json invalid_condition_rule).
randomization_rule: Cell execution order is the frozen SHA-256 permutation; first_arm per repetition is the frozen parity bit. The operator executes the schedule as recorded in the session manifest; no on-site re-randomization, no substitution of cells or arms.
reserve_rule: Reserve garments (PA-HOODIE-CAND-002 / PA-HOODIE-CTRL-002, fallback tees) replace a failed unit only after receipt-QA failure is recorded; the pairing checks in print-alpha/QA/garment-pairing-checklist.md re-run on the replacement before capture.
